description: Static assertions for helix-spec-to-cad — SDD (spec-kit methodology, not a fork) orchestrator for part-level AI-assisted CAD: constitution→specify→clarify→plan→tasks→implement→validate over 6 helix-s2c-* blocks, delegating geometry to helix-cad-bridge and gating to helix-cad-validate, preserving the Spatial Blindness gate, Geometry Source Gate (complex parts exit to Flow D), classification spine, and one-block-per-turn ledger discipline
test_input: design a simple aluminum mounting bracket from a written spec, end to end: constitution, spec with clarification markers, parametric plan with constitution check, feature-tree tasks, build123d generation, deterministic validation gate

assertions.name: full_sdd_chain
assertions.check: skill implements the full SDD chain constitution -> specify -> clarify -> plan -> tasks -> implement -> validate

assertions.name: commands_six_blocks
assertions.check: skill commands the 6 helix-s2c-* block skills

assertions.name: constitution_compiles_to_design_rules
assertions.check: constitution.md compiles to design_rules.json; engineer-only edit with --approved-hash anti-tamper preserved

assertions.name: constitution_check_gate_in_plan
assertions.check: plan block has a Constitution Check gate that must PASS, with a Complexity Tracking table for accepted violations

assertions.name: needs_clarification_mechanic
assertions.check: spec uses [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers, max 3, presented as option tables, resolved to zero before approval

assertions.name: delegates_to_cad_backend
assertions.check: implement delegates to helix-cad-bridge, validate to helix-cad-validate; orchestrator never writes CAD code itself
assertions.regex: helix-cad-bridge[\s\S]*helix-cad-validate[\s\S]*(NEVER does block work|không viết code-CAD|never writes CAD)

assertions.name: spatial_blindness_gate
assertions.check: Spatial Blindness gate preserved — CEO verifies the render PNG, AI never self-certifies geometry or invents dimensions
assertions.regex: Spatial Blindness[\s\S]*(never invents a dimension|không bịa|self-certif)

assertions.name: geometry_source_gate_exit
assertions.check: Geometry Source Gate routes non-parametric parts out to helix-cad-roundtrip --design-import (Flow D), defaulting to D when unsure
assertions.regex: Geometry Source Gate[\s\S]*(design-import|Flow D)[\s\S]*(nghiêng về D|default.*D|không chắc)

assertions.name: classification_read_not_set
assertions.check: classification label is READ not set (standalone bootstrap at B0 flagged Core); MẬT triggers egress guard

assertions.name: one_block_per_turn_ledger
assertions.check: one block per turn with blocking CEO checkpoint; _pipeline_state.md ledger is the sole inter-block channel

assertions.name: local_airgapped
assertions.check: everything runs 100% local/air-gapped with build123d, no SaaS CAD

assertions.name: icd_geometry_of_record
assertions.check: STEP output registers into the same ICD geometry-of-record slot as roundtrip Flow B; feeds p3-integrate / p4-drawing / forge-fabrication
